name: mmoollllee/filament-cms-core
description: The content engine of filament-cms (Laravel 12/13 + Filament v5): content types, the block builder, the RichEditor stack, drafts, versions, locking and media — for sites built on filament-cms and for apps that bring their own tenancy and panels.

suggest.pbmedia/laravel-ffmpeg: Re-encodes uploaded videos for the web (ConvertsUploadedVideos, ^8.9); needs an ffmpeg binary.
suggest.ralphjsmit/laravel-filament-media-librar: The media library behind every media field and the RichEditor's picker (^4.1, commercial — needs a licence and the satis.ralphjsmit.com repository). Wired automatically once installed.
suggest.mmoollllee/filament-media-library-extens: Upload button, inline and drop-zone uploads, auto-selection and the extended preview for the media picker (^0.2). Used automatically once installed.
suggest.mmoollllee/filami: Umami analytics; the spam-protected contact links report their clicks through it (^0.4).
